description: Reviewed eligibility policy for the HaUI admission corpus. Scope defaults keep older cycles in the corpus for explicit historical questions; per-document overrides quarantine drafts and record effective-date rules for regulations. This file never replaces corpus review state.

01_admission.note: Admission projects and notices are valid for their own admission year.

02_ministry_regulations.note: Ministry regulations are valid only inside their effective-date range.

03_cutoff_scores.note: Cutoff results answer only the year they were published for.

04_curriculum.note: Curriculum pages describe the 2026 cohort and must not answer another year's curriculum question.

05_tuition_scholarship.note: Tuition and scholarship amounts are cycle-specific.

06_career.note: Career and employer information is institutional context, not an admission-cycle fact.

07_career_orientation.note: Programme orientation pages describe stable career directions; old pages remain usable with their source year visible.

09_training_regulations.note: Training regulations are valid only inside their effective-date range.

10_dormitory_housing.note: Dormitory procedures, facilities, and contacts remain useful outside one admission cycle; dated 2026 notices carry their year in metadata.

11_student_life.note: Student clubs and youth-union information is evergreen.

12_student_support.note: Student support contacts and services are evergreen.

13_training_systems.note: Degree-system overview pages are evergreen; archived pages are retained for historical context.

14_about_haui.note: Institutional history, facilities, and awards are evergreen.

01_admission_003.note: Content is the 2026 admission plan (72 programmes, 8,300 regular places). The imported published_date of 2023-06-12 is inconsistent with the content; eligibility uses 2026 and the metadata anomaly should be corrected at the source.
